([[Ashburnham, Massachusetts]]) | college = *[[Duquesne Dukes men's basketball|Duquesne]] (2020–2022) *[[UIC Flames men's basketball|UIC]] (2022–2024) *[[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]] (2024–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | career_start = 2025 | years1 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–2026]] | team1 = [[Westchester Knicks]] | years2 = {{nbay|2025|end}} | team2 = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | highlights = }} '''Tochukwu Okani''' (born October 5, 2001) is an American [[basketball]] player who last played for the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played college basketball for the [[Duquesne Dukes men's basketball|Duquesne Dukes]], [[UIC Flames men's basketball|UIC Flames]], and [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia Mountaineers]]. ==Career== Okani spent two seasons at Duquesne before transferring to UIC. As a senior, he averaged 11.1 points, 6.8 rebounds, 2.0 blocks and 1.5 steals per game and was named to the [[Missouri Valley Conference]]’s All-Defensive Team. After UIC fired coach [[Luke Yaklich]], Okani entered the transfer portal.{{cite web |last1=Bidwell |first1=Ryan |title=UIC's Okani enters transfer portal |url=https://www.racerbasketball.com/p/uics-okani-enters-transfer-portal |website=RacerBasketball.com |access-date=April 6, 2026 |date=March 18, 2024}} In his sole season at West Virginia, Okani averaged 8.2 points and 4.1 rebounds per game.{{cite web |last1=Blain |first1=Luke |title=Former WVU Basketball G Toby Okani Signs 10-Day Contract With Memphis Grizzlies |url=https://wvsportsnow.com/former-wvu-basketball-g-toby-okani-signs-10-day-contract-with-memphis-grizzlies/ |website=WV Sports Now |access-date=April 6, 2026 |date=April 3, 2026}} Following his college career, Okani played for the [[Westchester Knicks]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He averaged 8.8 points and 4.2 rebounds over 13 games. He was then signed to a 10-day contract with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] of the NBA on April 3, 2026.{{cite web|title= Grizzlies Sign Dariq Whitehead and Toby Okani to 10-Day Contracts |url= https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-dariq-whitehead-and-toby-okani-to-10-day-contracts |website=nba.com|date=April 3, 2026|access-date=April 4, 2026}} He made his NBA debut on the same
